_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro: Siz uch o'yinchili tik-tak-to'da o'yinchi {player_id}siz. Sizning ramzingiz "{symbol}"dir. Siz o'zingizning ramzingizni 5x5 taxta ustiga joylashtirib, to'rtta chiziq hosil qilasiz. Chiziqlar gorizontal, vertikal yoki diagonal bo'lishi mumkin. 4-qadamni belgilash uchun "[4]" formatidan foydalanib harakatingizni taqdim eting.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O'tishning haqiqiy emas shakli. Katak 0-{max_cell} bo'lganda "[cell]" dan foydalaning.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Noto'g'ri katak raqami: {cell}. 0 va {max_cell} orasida bo'lishi kerak.
invalid_move.made_invalid: O'yinchi {player_id} haqiqiy bo'lmagan harakatni amalga oshirdi
